name: multinet_episodes_ended
description: MultiNet episode attempts that ended. outcome: solved/unsolved (finished and verified), infra_killed (API, billing or process kill; resumable), failed, or stale (the worker stopped heartbeating). end_kind: the episode's end_reason (agent_error:* as agent_error), else the outcome. Written by scripts/run_events.py.

labels.description: solved, unsolved, infra_killed, failed or stale.
Why it ended: success, max_steps, stalled, parse_failed, agent_error, ..., or failed / stale when no episode was uploaded.
